title: Collisions and coins
hints: rectsOverlap: a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y
circleRect: the nearest point is Math.max(rect.x, Math.min(circle.x, rect.x + rect.w)) and the same for y. Compare the squared distance with circle.r * circle.r.
collect: const remaining = coins.filter((coin) => !circleRect(coin, player)); the number collected is the difference in length.
